claims: Algeria defeated Guatemala 7-0 in an international friendly match played in Italy on March 27, 2026.
Guatemala was led by interim coach Salvador Reyes.
Salvador Reyes coached Guatemala in the match.
The match was a preparation for Algeria for their upcoming 2026 World Cup matches.
Amine Gouiri scored at 19' and 60' for Algeria.
Riyad Mahrez scored at 31' p for Algeria.
Achref Abada scored at 46' for Algeria.
Houssem Aouar scored at 47' for Algeria.
Farès Ghedjemis scored at 76' for Algeria.
Ahmed Benbouali scored at 82' for Algeria.
